name: chi-content-eigenbasis
description: Rewrites the Lean-proved χ_λ(𝓑_n−𝓑_p) H₃ relations in the content/twist eigenbasis so the structure is evident. The full twist Δ² acts on V_λ as the proved ribbon eigenvalue θ_λ=q^{2c(λ)} (c=content sum ∈ {3,0,−3}); the framing-summed tower is a 3-pole rational χ_λ/(1−t·q^{2c}) with poles at the twist eigenvalues; the bar-odd q-integer shape depends only on |c(λ)| (conjugate blocks (3),(1,1,1) share −¼([3]_q+[5]_q); (2,1) is ½([1]_q−[3]_q)); so the §4a single-x failure is a content-graded multi-mode object, not one q-Bessel. Exact symbolic re-expression of proved relations; nothing wired.
eigenbasis: content / twist (Jucys–Murphy content c(λ); full-twist ribbon eigenvalue θ_λ=q^{2c}, Lean-proved in QOU/BraidKnot/ChiralityWritheRibbon.lean)

framing_generating_function.form: Σ_m t^m θ_λ^m χ_λ = χ_λ / (1 − t·q^{2c(λ)})

reading: The content/twist eigenbasis makes the proved relations evident: conjugation = content reflection c→−c, the framing tower = a 3-pole rational at the twist eigenvalues, and the bar-odd tower is a |content|-graded multi-mode object — which is exactly why the §4a single-x q-Bessel test was structurally doomed.
